name: bib-finder
author: lumine-code
description: Search and insert BibTeX citation keys from bibliography files.
backgroundTips: You can insert a citation key from your BibTeX sources with {{ 'bib-finder:cite' | keystroke }}

bibLocal.title: Find local bibliography files
bibLocal.description: Find all `.bib' files in open projects and try to parse them.

ignoredNames.title: Ignored Names
ignoredNames.description: Additional glob patterns excluded while finding local bibliography files.

allowDuplicate.title: Allow duplicate keys
allowDuplicate.description: Allow duplicate keys in the list, otherwise only the first occurrence of the key will be displayed.

reloadAlways.title: Always reload keys from all `.bib` sources
reloadAlways.description: If not, you will need to manually run the `bib-finder:cache' command to re-cache the sources.

showSource.title: Show source path
showSource.description: Show the path of the source `.bib' file for each entry.

recentCount.title: Number of Recent Entries
recentCount.description: How many recently used entries to keep at the top of the list.

bibPaths.title: Bibliography sources as single path
bibPaths.description: Absolute paths to the bibliography files.

array.title: Array of sources
array.description: Array of paths, separated by commas.
